I had a delightful experience.
Sep 2023 • Couples
I recently had dinner at Chill Thai and had a delightful experience.
The Tom Yum🦐soup was an explosion of flavors - spicy and tangy, with just the right balance of heat. It warmed me up from the inside and left me craving for more.
The Moo Ping, a Thai street food classic, was simply amazing. The skewered pork was tender and well-marinated.
I ordered a refreshing lemon tea, which was a perfect choice.
I also tried the salmon sashimi, and it was surprisingly good, with a spicy-sweet sauce
Highly recommended!"

UNBELIEVABLY SHAMEFUL
Feb 2023
From the moment we walked in we should just turned around and walked out. WHY DID WE STAY……it cost us 729,300 for less than basic plates of food which is probably double the cost of normal Ho Chi Ming City restaurants. This might sound petty, but what you see on the menu is double the quantity of food that you actually receive.
It was 8.30pm this evening. There was a few people in there so we sat down, we tried numerous times to order and catch the staffs attention which proved very difficult. 15 mins later we were trying to order, staff were quickly clearing other tables, we put our order in, however the waiter was telling us, NOT advising us, what food to order. The reason we later found out was they were trying to get us in and out as soon as possible. Therefore recommending the quickest things to cook. So from the beginning we felt very rushed, some food came out cold, when sent back they just reheated the same food and sent it back out. when we complained to the manger we were met with a blank look. Absolutely outrageous. We have never experienced treatment like this before in any restaurant anywhere in the world. To top it all off, the food was Thai messy food and when I asked for a basic napkin to wipe my hands and mouth UNBELIEVABLY was told they charge for napkins…YES you’ve read it right, they charge for napkins...I was going to say please don’t go there but I personally don’t think it will be there much longer due to rudeness and arrogance of the staff.

Worst mega we had in Vietnam
Oct 2022 • Friends
We sat down and expected a really nice meal due to the prices being slightly higher than other places in this area. Instead, we sat down, got told we had to order within 5 minutes of doing so, and then, being asked to pay for the meal, 10 minutes after receiving the food, whilst eating. Our napkins got taken away from us as they were unused as we hadn’t finished eating. And our plates were taken before we were finished with them, and without being asked. When we complained to the staff, we were laughed at and our waitress ran off laughing to, who we assume was her manager. Who could only say sorry multiple times, and didn’t offer any excuse or compensation as we had already paid half way through our meal. So disappointed as the food was good.
